title: Feature Library Generator
description: Create a complete feature library with Next.js, TypeScript setup, optional authentication and HTTP client configuration. Creates apps/[name]/ with full project structure and all necessary configurations.

name.description: Name of the feature project (e.g., users, products, dashboard). Creates directory apps/[name]/ with all project files and configuration.
name.x-prompt: What name would you like to use for this feature?

directory.description: Override the directory where the feature project will be created (e.g., libs/ instead of apps/)

orgName.description: Organization name for scoped import paths (e.g., @myorg creates @myorg/[name] path alias)

type.description: Type of feature library to create. 'base' includes base components and logging, 'logging' includes only logging config, 'generic' is a plain feature library.

skipFormat.description: Skip prettier code formatting (used internally for chained generators)
